audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4 and 6 read 'Lucian' in both layers against a packet chart of Lucian, Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Skill, Skill, Maokai — and against this page's own whys[4] ('it's even') and whys[6] ('Maokai out-scales you hard'). The header was a three-way contradiction: diff HARD, the favoured-green tone, diffRating 4/10, and two lines reading 'Favoured matchup', on a 42.79% lane.
audit.why: Level 6 is not a swing for Lucian here — Nature's Grasp and the W root both survive or interrupt The Culling — and two-item Maokai tanks the double-shots outright.
audit.corrected: Row 4 set to Skill and row 6 to Maokai in both layers as matched pairs, ratings to 5/10 and 3/10. Header settled on EVEN 5.5/10 with the yellow tone and carry threat 6/10, which is the reading the chart and the 42.79% both support.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] sold level 6 as Lucian's ult spike with no acknowledgement that Maokai has two answers to a channel.
audit.why: Nature's Grasp is 130/110/90s at 3000 range and roots through the channel, and Twisted Advance roots on arrival — a Culling started on a healthy Maokai gets interrupted rather than executing him.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why restated as damage rather than a lane flip, naming both answers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere said that Maokai is UNTARGETABLE for the duration of Twisted Advance, and the page's Do's told the player to count the root's cooldown without ever giving its number.
audit.why: Riot's W text: 'Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target.' A Lucian who fires Q or starts The Culling as the W animation begins loses the whole commit into an untargetable window — the exact failure the missingInteractions rule flags. It is 525 range on 14/13/12/11/10s.
audit.corrected: The untargetable window plus the range and 14s cooldown written into report[5].t, with the hold-your-burst instruction; dosFull[2].d now prices the whiff at 14 seconds; dontsFull[0].d names Sap Magic and the Grievous Wounds requirement.
sources: enemyKit Maokai W text and untargetable flag, P text

notes: The header call is Medium confidence. diff said HARD, the tone hex said favoured-green, diffRating said 4/10 and both rating lines said 'Favoured matchup' — four fields, three different answers, on a lane Lucian wins 42.79% of. I settled all four on EVEN 5.5/10 because the packet chart still gives Lucian rows 0-2 and only concedes the last row, which is not a hard matchup shape; but if the user prefers the 42.79% to drive it, TRICKY 7/10 is the alternative and only these four fields need to move. Also: the content early/mid/late blocks here are in first person ('exactly the slow melee I want early'), the same voice defect as lucian__kennen and lucian__ksante — three matchups now, so it looks like a batch rather than a one-off.
